dedupe_keys.name: opsim open source chemical engineering process simulator

description: An open-source chemical process simulator with a graphical flowsheet editor. The GitHub README says OpSim is a chemical engineering process simulator with a drag-and-drop graphical user interface and a high-performance simulation engine, cross-platform on Linux, Windows and Mac, with binaries on the release page and source built with the Free Pascal Compiler, under the GPL-2.0 licence, all free to download. Coverage is generic chemical processes. Caveats: the page read does not show the component library, thermodynamic methods or recent activity. For simulation it offers a free way to model how a chemical process responds to loss of feed, utilities or equipment, as input to plant disruption studies. A related catalogue record is the DWSIM process simulator.
